records.title: songs for agreement
records.why: Gosh what an album… I don’t even know where to start, the melodies, the lyrics. The production, the sound!? Listened to this whole thing on a stroll around the park nearby. Yup, “Arkansas” had me in tears in public. Lovely album that I’ve had on repeat for several days now. Congrats Benjamin, real great work!

records.title: What Would You Like To Do Now?
The End of the End of the World (feat. Jason Pilling)

records.why: Honestly, picking a favorite track is a crime because, for me,  it changes constantly, but I think this is my daughter's favorite track. The hook gets stuck in my head, the bridge makes me hungry. What more can you want. Dig it!

records.title: SOLO PIANO
records.why: This is the second track I heard, and all I needed to convince me to buy the whole collection, great work!
